Summary: Job Alerts 🔔 — daily verified job alerts for saved guest searches
Description: A guest who completes a search can subscribe with one tap to daily alerts for that exact role/experience/city. A dispatcher runs after each day's scrape and sends ONLY new, never-before-sent, verified jobs from the Watch Tower (same deterministic _job_reply pipeline — no model-authored facts, ever). One tap to stop anytime. This is the retention engine of Sprint 1.1 'Come Back Tomorrow' and the foundation of the selling-engine vision (Vigil 2.0 needs guests who return daily).
Acceptance Criteria:
1. One-tap subscribe button appears after any successful search result
2. Alert messages contain only verified tower jobs the guest has never been sent before (dedupe by job id per subscription)
3. Zero new jobs = no message that day (silence beats spam)
4. One-tap / one-command unsubscribe works instantly and is confirmed
5. Dispatch runs only after the daily scrape completes — never during/before, never while the tower is hot
6. Ashok can see subscriber count, last dispatch time, and failures from Telegram
7. A guest who blocked the bot is auto-paused, never retried forever
Definition of Done: All SIMET children Done; full test suite green; deployed via the normal pipeline with JOBMASTER_TELEGRAM_VERDICT=PASS; validation cases added to jobmaster-telegram-validation.md; Ashok subscribes on his own phone, receives a real next-day alert, unsubscribes, and explicitly accepts live. Code merged + tests passing is evidence, not closure.
